name: aims
description: Makes design the goal of coding-agent work, and makes the design knowledge durable. A design method (discovery, feasibility gate, ownership/encapsulation, a subtractive pass, a review panel) delegates a design objective to a Worker, then files the resulting ADRs, requirements, components, and insights as records co-located with the code (the directory structure is both the code graph and the knowledge tree) — so a later clean session reads prior conclusions instead of re-deriving. One advisory read-time hook flags documentation that drifted from the code; nothing runs in the background. Commands: /aims-plan, /aims-build, /aims-review, /aims-plan-and-build, /install-on.
